localAdaptations.counting: different deployed recruitable unit IDs; bench, duplicates and summoned fighters do not increase counts
localAdaptations.timing: opening snapshot; provider death or charm does not recalculate formation
localAdaptations.summons: later summons inherit four/six-beast team speed, never two-beast personal speed or vanguard armor
localAdaptations.intervalFormula: max(1 tick, gearAdjustedBaseInterval / (1 + formationSpeed + activeStaffGaleSpeed) * temporaryHasteFactor * activeSlowFactor)
localAdaptations.limits: 精确攻速叠加、最低间隔、召唤继承、锁定和控制边界为本地适配；引擎以0.25秒离散步进。当前野兽10种/先锋12种的本地名单仍不同于五月7/7，不声称整个阵容已经同版本复原。
